semantic_reference.name: Mega Man X6 Tweaks Workbook v2.0
semantic_reference.limits: Names/roles are research labels; runtime reachability is unverified.

coverage_rules.evidence: Record candidate identities, prerequisites/bypasses, inputs, RAM/actor observations, visuals and muted audio as applicable
coverage_rules.scope: Actual authored table records, not proof of mechanics, reachability or complete dynamic actor/route coverage

disc_input.verification: Selected EXE and BIN bytes pinned; no whole-disc hash claimed

placement_evidence.limits: Static tables include scenery/controllers/variant records. Dynamic producers, native prerequisites and runtime actor identities require separate audit.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Zero admission
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Enter alternate routes under native pre-Zero story conditions; each seat triggers the real boss scene, including an absent/dead partner; retain the admitted encounter identity.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Zero fight and Zero unlock
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Defeat Nightmare Zero using accepted attacks and verify reward, Zero unlock, return cutscene and actual next screen once; repeat each scene owner and valid native character.

mechanics_obligations.title: Alternate High Max admission
mechanics_obligations.procedure: After native Zero unlock, enter each alternate destination through its real teleport and verify High Max replaces the prior boss without forced encounter flags.

mechanics_obligations.title: High Max damage prerequisites
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise native stun/weapon prerequisites from each seat, with one survivor and both alive; verify accepted and rejected hits, health and exactly-once death.

mechanics_obligations.title: High Max victory campaign unlock
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Defeat alternate High Max natively; observe Gate-stage access, story report and card persistence without writing stage-unlock flags.

mechanics_obligations.title: Dynamo story replacement
mechanics_obligations.procedure: After the native prerequisite, enter alternate arenas and verify Dynamo admission/AI replaces the prior boss for both scene owners.

mechanics_obligations.title: Dynamo soul rewards
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Use the native reward interaction and repeated encounter; count spawned/collected souls and exit transitions with either collector and simultaneous attacks.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Mother encounter
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Reach Secret Lab 1 boss admission natively; exercise both entities, hazard phases, either-player damage/death and boss clear transition.

mechanics_obligations.title: Fortress High Max encounter
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Use the fortress route and native character branch; verify boss prerequisites and clear advance rather than bypassing its gate.

mechanics_obligations.title: Gate encounter
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise Gate arena moving platforms and attack-generated projectiles with both seats and survivor play; verify native damage rules and actual clear advance.

mechanics_obligations.title: Investigator refight sequence
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Visit all 18 authored slot0C/0 checkpoints and every refight teleporter; retain each boss identity, exit, completed marker and final-gate admission. Check dynamic spawn coverage separately.

mechanics_obligations.title: Sigma phases and endings
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Defeat both final phases through native attacks with each available character/seat owner; verify transitions, ending/credits and cold-load progression.

mechanics_obligations.title: Reploid rescue ownership
mechanics_obligations.procedure: For all 128 indexed Reploids, rescue by either seat and simultaneous contact; verify one rescue and one set of rewards with no unintended partner heal.

mechanics_obligations.title: Reploid infection/loss
mechanics_obligations.procedure: At each indexed Reploid permit native Nightmare contact, observe infection/loss, then retry/re-enter; record resulting found-state nibble and reward availability.

mechanics_obligations.title: Reploid healing and extra life
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Rescue at low/full health with either collector and an absent/dead partner; verify delayed heal ownership and exactly-once life reward.

mechanics_obligations.title: Reploid parts grants
mechanics_obligations.procedure: For each item-carrying Reploid verify the native part/Life Up/Energy Up grant, report and equipment availability for both seats; read back copied-card continuation.

mechanics_obligations.title: Reploid irreversible state persistence
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Using private native-card copies, save rescued/infected/lost states, cold boot and continue; verify all 128 found-state entries and previously granted items.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Soul pickup ownership
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Collect enemy and boss souls by either seat and simultaneously; verify shared/personal policy, exact count, disappearance and no duplicate pickup.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Soul rank boundaries
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Earn through every original threshold (200,300,500,800,1200,5000,9999) by native pickups from one below; verify rank and parts capacity independently for X and Zero.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Soul retry persistence
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Collect souls, die/checkpoint-retry, leave stage, save and cold continue; observe native count/rank retention and both-peer agreement.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare effect propagation
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Visit each Investigator stage, leave by native transition and read affected-stage effects; verify overwrite/order behavior and cold-load state against the native effect table.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Bug
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Create Bug through its native source visit, enter every affected stage and exercise player interaction, attacks and lifetime in unified/split/private views.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Ice
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Create Ice through its native source visit and test slippery terrain, collision and enemy/platform interaction in every affected route.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Fire
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Create Fire through its native source visit and test actual fire hazards and altered ice/wall behavior with each player and both alive.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Iron
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Create Iron through its native source visit and exercise falling/moving solids, damage and camera admission for either seat.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Cube
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Create Cube through its native source visit and exercise cube solidity, weapon interactions and progression on each affected route.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Rain
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Create Rain through its native source visit; check rain rendering, visibility, water/terrain interactions and private-render restoration across aspects.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Mirror
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Create Mirror through its native source visit; exercise mirror appearances, collision/damage and ownership with both characters/seats.

mechanics_obligations.title: Nightmare Dark
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Create Dark through its native source visit; verify darkness/light presentation and native gameplay visibility with independently positioned players.

mechanics_obligations.title: Falcon X movement
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise native Falcon air movement, dash, wall behavior and charge/weapon usage in either seat; verify personal effects and checkpoint/menu restoration.

mechanics_obligations.title: Blade X Mach Dash
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise native charge/hold/direction/release and collision in all directions from either seat; verify no partner input, sound or damage ownership leakage.

mechanics_obligations.title: Blade X attacks
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise Blade saber, charged buster and weapon interactions in either seat; count actor/effect updates and valid damage once per simulation frame.

mechanics_obligations.title: Shadow X movement
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise native ceiling/wall attachment, jumps, spikes and armor-dependent route access in either seat; verify camera and moving-solid interaction.

mechanics_obligations.title: Shadow X attacks
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise Shadow charge/saber/projectiles and weapon restrictions in either seat; verify damage, voice and effect ownership.

mechanics_obligations.title: Ultimate X
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Enable only through the supported native code/unlock path; test Nova Strike, charge, resource use, menus and seat ownership; disclose any bypassed progression.

mechanics_obligations.title: Zero techniques
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Earn every Investigator technique then exercise native directional/air/ground command conditions in either seat; validate accepted hits, personal energy and actor ownership.

mechanics_obligations.title: Black Zero
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Unlock/select through the supported native path; verify palette, defense/offense and native bonus parts/technique behavior in either seat and after cold load.

mechanics_obligations.title: Armor capsule collection
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Reach every capsule and collect by either seat; verify native character restrictions, dialogue owner, per-piece grant and armor-completion unlock.

mechanics_obligations.title: Heart and weapon upgrades
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Collect every authored Heart Tank and Energy/Life Up; verify supported sharing policy, cap/HUD change, single consumption and native save retention.

mechanics_obligations.title: Subtank collection and filling
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Collect each tank then fill at full health/weapon energy with either seat; verify recipient, capacity and no duplicated fill on split/private rendering.

mechanics_obligations.title: Rank-limited parts equipment
mechanics_obligations.procedure: At each rank capacity, independently open personal menus, equip/unequip normal and limited-use parts; verify X/Zero restrictions and consumption on actual use.

mechanics_obligations.title: Amazon Area terrain
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Audit narrow ceilings, blind drops, moving terrain and boss door from either camera/scene owner; verify alternate teleport and native destination.

mechanics_obligations.title: North Pole ice and avalanches
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise ice blocks, avalanche/spike/cave sections and armor-dependent access with both players; retain contact, death/retry and alternate-route evidence.

mechanics_obligations.title: Magma Nightmare Snake rooms
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise every scripted Snake wave/room, vertical scrolling, moving lava and exit; verify native wave prerequisites and either-player admission.

mechanics_obligations.title: Recycle Lab press
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise compressing/crushing solids and scrap/terrain changes at primary checkpoint sections; verify safe riding and lethal contact for each seat.

mechanics_obligations.title: Recycle Lab Ride Armor
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Enter/exit native Ride Armor with either seat, collide/attack/take damage and transition/lose it; verify ownership, passenger policy and retry.

mechanics_obligations.title: Central Museum room selection
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Enumerate native room-choice state and every realized room chain/warp, mapping the 516 authored primary records; verify randomized variants rather than one lucky route.

mechanics_obligations.title: Inami Temple acid rain
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise rain exposure/shelter, recovery, switches and actual hazard damage by each seat across camera separation; verify native route progression.

mechanics_obligations.title: Laser Institute mirrors
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise native laser/mirror aiming, blocking, solidity, teleport rooms and boss/alternate-door requirements with each seat and the partner offscreen.

mechanics_obligations.title: Weapon Center Illumina
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Exercise the native large enemy/projectile sequence, scrolling and destruction/transition triggers with either attacker/camera owner; retain alternate-area admission.

mechanics_obligations.title: Fortress armor-sensitive geometry
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Run each native X/Zero route and all supported armor movement sets through Gate-lab terrain, spikes, large gaps and moving solids; record actual access restrictions.

mechanics_obligations.title: Native stage prerequisites
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Unlock fortress through each supported native route, including soul/rank and boss conditions; verify stage select/report plus reload without pre-setting success flags.

mechanics_obligations.title: Character progression divergence
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Earn upgrades/techniques with differing X/Zero history and swap seats/menus; verify intended shared and personal progress, scene identity and native restrictions.

mechanics_obligations.title: Private-card save/load
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Save from stage select/report, cold boot and continue with private copies; compare items, armor, parts, techniques, souls/ranks, found Reploids, Nightmare state and campaign flags.

mechanics_obligations.title: Current-build snapshot mid-mechanic
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Save/load and rewind/rollback where supported during rescue, infection, Snake waves, room warps, armor movement and Gate fight; verify current-build state and native-card isolation.

mechanics_obligations.title: Netplay campaign traversal
mechanics_obligations.procedure: Run actual two-peer stage clear, alternate teleport, refight and ending transitions under latency/jitter; compare accepted inputs, core/mod checksums and native progression at every boundary.

known_gaps: Native slots09/0A have checkpoint records but unresolved semantic roles.
Menu/cutscene namespaces have records; these are not asserted playable routes.
Recycle Lab section0 contains four checkpoint records not enumerated by the workbook checkpoint note.
Refight slot0C/0 contains18 checkpoint records; admission/ordering and dynamic bosses still need native runtime evidence.
Central Museum authored records include room variants; randomized room-choice graph and reachable combinations are unverified.
Boss-stage identity depends on story/character/encounter state; alternate tables alone do not enumerate Nightmare Zero/High Max/Dynamo substitutions.
Dynamic actors, every route/exit, actor identity mapping and transitions are not fully derived from these static tables.
No local co-op or netplay gameplay validation is implied by inventory extraction.
